name: uid0-user
description: Practice-box misconfiguration: creates (or repoints) an account and gives it UID/GID 0 -- a second all-powerful root-equivalent user. Vars: USERNAME (required), PASSWORD (optional).
script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

: "${USERNAME:?USERNAME is required}"

if id "$USERNAME" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    usermod -o -u 0 -g 0 "$USERNAME"
else
    useradd -m -o -u 0 -g 0 -s /bin/bash "$USERNAME"
fi

if [ -n "${PASSWORD-}" ]; then
    printf '%s:%s\n' "$USERNAME" "$PASSWORD" | chpasswd
fi
